title: Measured reverse unit propagation and RUP refutation verification
claims: ExactRUPRefutationVerifier checks the exact polynomial-time refutation relation on canonical encoded formulas and traces and proves its soundness.
MeasuredRUP and MeasuredRUPRun decide the pinned reverse unit propagation and learning predicates on canonical inputs.
BoundedRUPRefutationsInNP gives a measured verifier for formula languages with a polynomial encoded certificate budget.
RUPCoverageCoNP proves a conditional coNP bound for guarded SAT when unsatisfiable guarded inputs have polynomial encoded RUP traces.
ExactUnitRefutableCNF checks the P language of formulas refutable by unit propagation with no initial assumptions.
HornUnitRefutation characterizes unsatisfiable Horn formulas by one empty-clause RUP check.

experiments.purpose: Bind the archived Lean modules and exact statements to the recorded local reference replay. The isolated experiment reports zero Lean invocations and can be complemented by replay with the pinned reference.
